instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 11(a)
instructions.quote: institutions shall disclose information on their exposures towards non-financial corporates operating in carbon-related sectors, and on the quality of those exposures, including IFRS 9 stage 2 and non-performing status classification,

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 13
instructions.quote: Institutions shall include in the rows of the template the breakdown of the gross carrying amount of loans and advances, debt securities and equity instruments to non-financial corporations, other than those held for trading, by sector of economic activities

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 13
instructions.quote: the sectors listed in Sections A to H and Section M of Annex to Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/137, within those Sections B to D and G defined as fossil fuel sectors by Article 4 (153) of CRR,

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 14
instructions.quote: The counterparty NACE sector allocation shall be based on the nature of the direct counterparty.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 14
instructions.quote: The classification of the exposures incurred jointly by more than one obligor shall be based on the characteristics of the obligor that was the more relevant, or determinant, for the institution to grant the exposure.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 15, column a
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose the total gross carrying amount, referred to in Part 1 of Annex V – Reporting on Financial Information (FINREP), of those exposures towards non-financial corporates, including loans and advances, debt securities and equity instruments

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 15, column c
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose exposures that are financing activities that contribute to mitigating climate change related transition risks,

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 15, columns i1, i2 and j
instructions.quote: Where the information is available, institutions shall disclose reported emissions i.e. emissions data directly provided by their counterparties. Where reported emissions are not available, institutions shall disclose estimated emissions.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 15, columns l – p
instructions.quote: where an exposure has no stated maturity for reasons other than the counterparty having the choice of the repayment date, or in the case of equity holdings, the amount of this exposure shall be disclosed in the largest maturity bucket

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 18
instructions.quote: Institutions shall include in this template information on exposures in the banking book, including loans and advances, debt securities and equity instruments not held-for-trading and not held-for-sale, towards non-financial corporates,

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 18
instructions.quote: exposures to households collateralised by immovable property and on collateral obtained by taking possession, exposed to climate-related physical risk events, with a breakdown by:

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 19
instructions.quote: ‘exposures subject to climate-related physical risk events’ refer to exposures where the counterparty, activity, or underlying collateral is subject to climate-related physical hazards, based on the geographical location and nature of the exposure, and hazard intensity,

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 21
instructions.quote: The classification of the joint exposures towards more than one obligor shall be based on the characteristics of the obligor that was the most relevant for the institution to grant the exposure.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 23
instructions.quote: the identification and assessment of exposures subject to climate-related physical risk are conducted at the highest possible level of geographical granularity (i.e. using precise geolocalisation of counterparties’ assets and activities) and, at a minimum, at NUTS level 3.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 a)
instructions.quote: In addition to the Total exposures, institutions shall disclose in the z-axis, the geographical information covering the countries where exposures subject to climate-related physical risk were identified:

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 a) i)
instructions.quote: Country by country information for those countries where the institution has material exposures subject to climate change physical risk.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 a) ii)
instructions.quote: Other EU exposures for the rest of exposures subject to physical risk that are not reported on a country-by-country basis.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 b)
instructions.quote: In the rows, the relevant sectors of the counterparty will be disclosed following the NACE code classification. The following sectors shall be disclosed separately by the institutions in rows 1 - 9:

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 b)
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose in row 10 – Other sectors those exposures subject to climate-related physical risk not covered with the sectoral breakdown by rows 1 – 9.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 b)
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose respectively in rows 11 to 13 exposures collateralised by residential immovable property, exposures collateralised by commercial immovable property and collateral obtained by taking possession. For row 13, only columns a-f should be completed.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 b)
instructions.quote: Institutions shall classify and report exposures secured by both commercial and residential immovable property based on the predominant use of the collateral as referred to in Part 1 of the Annex V – Reporting on Financial Information (FINREP)

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 c), column a
instructions.quote: The sum of the amounts to be disclosed in rows 1 to 10 of this template shall be identical to the final sum of the amount disclosed in column a of EU CRFR1

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 c), column a
instructions.quote: For exposures collateralised by commercial and residential immovable property, institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount not limited to non-financial corporates, matching the gross carrying amount of the loans collateralised by immovable property reported in FINREP.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 c), column b
instructions.quote: exposures should be disclosed as subject to climate-related physical risk if any of the main activities is located in an area likely to be affected by physical risk event.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 c), column b
instructions.quote: in relation to the location of financed assets, and there are multiple locations of assets financed by the same exposure, they should follow a proportionate allocation similar as for exposures collateralised by residential immovable property.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 c), column b
instructions.quote: For exposures collateralised by residential immovable property, institutions shall identify exposures subject to climate-related physical risk in relation to the location of collateral.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 c), columns c - f
instructions.quote: The disclosure by hazard type shall therefore not be mutually exclusive, and the same exposure may be reported under multiple hazard categories. The sum of exposures reported across individual hazard types may exceed the total exposures subject to physical risk.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 c), column c
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose the exposures subject to temperature-related hazards, as classified by COMMISSION DELEGATED REGULATION (EU) 2023/2486.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 c), column d
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose the exposures sensitive to wind-related hazards, as classified by COMMISSION DELEGATED REGULATION (EU) 2023/2486.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 c), column e
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose the exposures subject to water-related hazards, as classified by COMMISSION DELEGATED REGULATION (EU) 2023/2486.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 25 c), column f
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose the exposures subject to solid mass-related hazards, as classified by COMMISSION DELEGATED REGULATION (EU) 2023/2486.

instructions.ref: Annex XL (IT solutions), Part 1, para 35 (EU CRFR3, multi-collateral)
instructions.quote: For those exposures linked to more than one immovable property collateral, institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount of the exposure split in proportion to the value of the collateral.
